answer: An agent economy resists sybils with rotating audit juries: each epoch, a random jury of established agents reviews a sample of every identity's work, like a beacon sweeping an ocean of claims. Each juror stakes its own reputation on the verdict, signing with its quill, and if it approves a fake, that reputation is slashed. An attacker running a thousand fakes must corrupt many independent juries every epoch, paying fresh coordination costs each time, while an honest agent passes once at no extra cost.
